title: 米国企業の5年推移
question: この米国企業の売上・営業利益・純利益・FCF は直近5年でどう動いたか
sql:
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_year_end, name,
       ROUND(revenue_usd / 1e6, 0) AS revenue_musd, ROUND(operating_income_usd / 1e6, 0) AS operating_income_musd,
       ROUND(net_income_usd / 1e6, 0) AS net_income_musd, ROUND(fcf_usd / 1e6, 0) AS fcf_musd,
       ROUND(operating_margin * 100, 1) AS operating_margin_pct, ROUND(sales_growth_1y * 100, 1) AS sales_growth_pct
FROM m_us_fin_annual
WHERE ticker = {{ticker}}
ORDER BY fiscal_year_end
note: 金額は百万ドル。年度は期末日の年。

title: 業種別の営業利益率（米国）
question: 米国の業種（SIC）ごとに営業利益率はどれくらいか
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(不明)') AS industry_name, COUNT(*) AS companies,
       ROUND(AVG(operating_margin) * 100, 1) AS avg_operating_margin_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(operating_income_usd) / NULLIF(SUM(revenue_usd), 0) * 100, 1) AS weighted_margin_pct
FROM m_us_fin_annual
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND revenue_usd > 0 AND operating_margin BETWEEN -1 AND 1
GROUP BY industry_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{min_companies}}
ORDER BY weighted_margin_pct DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}
note: weighted は業種の営業利益合計÷売上合計（大企業の影響が大きい）。avg は会社ごとの単純平均。

title: 業種別の売上成長率（米国）
question: 米国のどの業種が売上を伸ばしているか
sql:
SELECT COALESCE(industry, '(不明)') AS industry_name, COUNT(*) AS companies,
       ROUND(AVG(sales_growth_1y) * 100, 1) AS avg_sales_growth_pct,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN sales_growth_1y > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 0) AS growing_share_pct
FROM m_us_fin_annual
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND sales_growth_1y BETWEEN -0.9 AND 3
GROUP BY industry_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{min_companies}}
ORDER BY avg_sales_growth_pct DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}
note: 前年比は前の通期が330〜400日前にある会社だけ。−90%〜+300%の外は外れ値として除く。

title: 売上高ランキング（米国）
question: 米国で売上が大きい会社はどこか
sql:
SELECT ticker, name, industry, ROUND(revenue_usd / 1e9, 1) AS revenue_busd, ROUND(operating_margin * 100, 1) AS operating_margin_pct,
       ROUND(sales_growth_1y * 100, 1) AS sales_growth_pct
FROM m_us_fin_annual
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND revenue_usd > 0
ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

title: FCFマージンの高い会社（米国）
question: 売上に対してフリーCFを多く生む米国企業はどこか
sql:
SELECT ticker, name, industry, ROUND(revenue_usd / 1e9, 1) AS revenue_busd, ROUND(fcf_margin * 100, 1) AS fcf_margin_pct,
       ROUND(operating_margin * 100, 1) AS operating_margin_pct
FROM m_us_fin_annual
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND revenue_usd >= {{min_revenue_busd}} * 1e9 AND fcf_margin BETWEEN -1 AND 1
ORDER BY fcf_margin DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

title: 株主還元額ランキング（米国）
question: 配当と自社株買いで株主に多く返している米国企業はどこか
sql:
SELECT ticker, name, ROUND((COALESCE(dividends_paid_usd, 0) + COALESCE(buyback_usd, 0)) / 1e9, 1) AS total_return_busd,
       ROUND(COALESCE(dividends_paid_usd, 0) / 1e9, 1) AS dividends_busd, ROUND(COALESCE(buyback_usd, 0) / 1e9, 1) AS buyback_busd,
       ROUND((COALESCE(dividends_paid_usd, 0) + COALESCE(buyback_usd, 0)) / NULLIF(fcf_usd, 0) * 100, 0) AS payout_of_fcf_pct
FROM m_us_fin_annual
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND (dividends_paid_usd IS NOT NULL OR buyback_usd IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY total_return_busd DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}
note: payout_of_fcf は還元額÷FCF（100%超は FCF 以上を返している）。

title: ROEの分布（米国）
question: 米国企業のROEはどう分布しているか
sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN roe < 0 THEN '1 赤字' WHEN roe < 0.05 THEN '2 0〜5%' WHEN roe < 0.10 THEN '3 5〜10%' WHEN roe < 0.15 THEN '4 10〜15%' WHEN roe < 0.25 THEN '5 15〜25%' ELSE '6 25%以上' END AS roe_band,
       COUNT(*) AS companies
FROM m_us_fin_annual
WHERE fiscal_year = {{fiscal_year}} AND roe IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY roe_band
ORDER BY roe_band
note: ROE＝純利益÷株主資本（株主資本が正の会社だけ）。

title: 米国企業のセグメント別売上の推移
question: この米国企業の売上は、事業・製品・地域ごとにどう動いたか
sql:
SELECT fiscal_year, segment_name, ROUND(revenue_usd / 1e6, 0) AS revenue_musd, ROUND(operating_income_usd / 1e6, 0) AS operating_income_musd,
       ROUND(revenue_share * 100, 1) AS revenue_share_pct, ROUND(revenue_growth_1y * 100, 1) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM m_us_segments
WHERE ticker = {{ticker}} AND axis_ja = {{axis_ja}}
ORDER BY fiscal_year, revenue_usd DESC

params.name: axis_ja
params.label: 軸（事業／製品・サービス／地域）

note: SEC の決算データ（Financial Statement Data Sets）。会社が開示した軸だけ。比率は全社売上に対する割合。製品・サービスの軸には「Product」「Service」のような合計の行と内訳の行が並ぶ会社があり、足すと100%を超えることがある。

title: 最新期のセグメント構成（米国）
question: この米国企業の最新期の売上は、どのセグメントにどれだけ依存しているか
sql:
SELECT axis_ja, segment_name, ROUND(revenue_usd / 1e6, 0) AS revenue_musd, ROUND(revenue_share * 100, 1) AS revenue_share_pct,
       ROUND(operating_margin * 100, 1) AS operating_margin_pct, ROUND(revenue_growth_1y * 100, 1) AS revenue_growth_pct
FROM m_us_segments
WHERE ticker = {{ticker}} AND is_latest
ORDER BY axis_ja, revenue_usd DESC
note: 営業利益をセグメント別に開示するのは主に事業セグメント。

title: 伸びているセグメント（米国）
question: 売上の大きいセグメントのうち、前年比で最も伸びているのはどれか
sql:
SELECT ticker, name, axis_ja, segment_name, fiscal_year, ROUND(revenue_usd / 1e6, 0) AS revenue_musd,
       ROUND(revenue_growth_1y * 100, 1) AS revenue_growth_pct, ROUND(revenue_share * 100, 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM m_us_segments
WHERE is_latest AND revenue_usd >= {{min_revenue_musd}} * 1e6 AND revenue_growth_1y IS NOT NULL AND revenue_growth_1y <= 10
ORDER BY revenue_growth_1y DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

params.name: min_revenue_musd
params.label: セグメント売上の下限（百万ドル）

note: セグメント名の付け替え（再編）があると前年が無く空になる。

title: 事業セグメントの利益率（米国）
question: この米国企業の事業セグメントごとの営業利益率は
sql:
SELECT fiscal_year, segment_name, ROUND(revenue_usd / 1e6, 0) AS revenue_musd, ROUND(operating_income_usd / 1e6, 0) AS operating_income_musd,
       ROUND(operating_margin * 100, 1) AS operating_margin_pct
FROM m_us_segments
WHERE ticker = {{ticker}} AND axis = 'BusinessSegments' AND operating_income_usd IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fiscal_year, revenue_usd DESC
note: 営業利益を事業セグメント別に開示している会社だけ。

title: 特定地域への売上依存（米国）
question: ある地域（例: China）の売上比率が高い米国企業はどこか
sql:
SELECT ticker, name, industry, segment_name, fiscal_year, ROUND(revenue_usd / 1e6, 0) AS revenue_musd,
       ROUND(revenue_share * 100, 1) AS revenue_share_pct
FROM m_us_segments
WHERE is_latest AND axis = 'Geographical' AND member LIKE {{member_like}} AND revenue_usd >= {{min_revenue_musd}} * 1e6
ORDER BY revenue_share DESC
LIMIT {{limit}}

params.name: member_like
params.label: 地域名の一部（英語・% で前後を囲む）

params.name: min_revenue_musd
params.label: その地域の売上の下限（百万ドル）

note: 地域名は会社ごとの表記（China・CN・GreaterChina など）。大文字小文字を区別する。比率は全社売上に対する割合。
